name: Durkar
blurb: Five minutes from Durkar via Painthorpe Lane. Handy if you're coming off the M1 at J39 for a groom.
metaDescription: Dog grooming near Durkar — a 5-minute drive to Keith's K9 Care in Hall Green, Wakefield WF4. Handy off the M1 J39. One dog at a time. Book today.
lead: Five minutes from Durkar via Painthorpe Lane — and an easy hop off the M1 at J39 — Keith's K9 Care is a calm, one-to-one home dog grooming salon.
body: Durkar is a quick run from us down Painthorpe Lane, and handy if you're coming off the M1 at junction 39 — drop the dog for a groom on your way through, or on the way home from work. There's easy parking right outside the salon on Castle Meadows, so no circling for a space and no high-street traffic.

Keith's K9 Care is a home salon built around one dog at a time. A quiet, purpose-built room, no kennels, no shared dryers, no other dogs in earshot — just your dog and Keith. It's a calm setup that suits puppies, nervous dogs and older dogs, and it lets Keith work at your dog's pace instead of rushing to fit the next appointment in.

Every coat type is welcome, and Keith — IPET-qualified, trained at Mrs B's in Leeds — offers the full menu: full grooms, puppy first grooms, bath and tidy, nail trims, de-matting and traditional hand stripping. Prices are published in full with breed examples, and confirmed before he starts.
Whether it's a standing six-week appointment or a one-off, booking your Durkar dog in is a quick call, WhatsApp or message. Keith likes a quick chat about coat, age and temperament first.

faqs.q: How do I get to you from Durkar?
faqs.a: About 1.8 miles — five minutes down Painthorpe Lane to Castle Meadows in Hall Green (WF4), with easy parking outside.

faqs.q: I commute via M1 J39 — can I drop my dog on the way?
faqs.a: Yes — we're a couple of minutes from J39, which makes a drop-off on the commute or school run easy. Keith will agree a drop-off and pick-up time when you book.
In full, with breed-by-breed examples on the pricing page — no ringing round for a quote. Keith confirms the exact price in person before starting.
